Aria: Quick shoutout — Sam brought homemade shortbread for the onboarding demo and also jumped into the backend call when staging lagged. Saved the show! :heart: :tada:
Sam: ahhh thanks y'all. happy the cookies helped. big props to Lina for staying late to patch the config — absolute legend.
Lina: teamwork ftw. also quick heads-up — ceramics club tonight 6pm in breakroom B. bring a mug if you want to test glazes :pottery: :grin:
Priya: Sam + Lina = heroes. cookies + config fixes = 10/10 combo :cookie: :gear:
Mateo: Can we get a round of :clap:? Also quick poll: morning coffee run tomorrow? react :coffee: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no.
Marcus: Coffee please! Also Sam, you better share that shortbread recipe :pray:
Sam: recipe DM'ing Marcus now. Also slides from the onboarding/demo are here (view-only): https://company.share/slides/onboarding-demo
DevBot: deploy-bot: notice — staging fallback triggered at 21:13; rollback completed after config patch; no errors reported.
Aria: and triple thanks to DevBot for the calm logs :robot_face: :sparkles: (:tada: x3)
Priya: if anyone wants to join ceramics, I put a sign-up sheet in #people-ops — ping me if you need the link.
Aria: love seeing cross-team help like this. small gestures, big impact. passing the kudos baton — who wants to shout someone out next?
